sections.title: Reading & Listening — eating habits around the world
sections.titleUz: O'qish va tinglash — dunyodagi ovqatlanish odatlari

exercises.instructionEn: Read the sentences, then listen and mark them as T (true) or F (false).
exercises.instructionUz: Gaplarni o'qing, so'ng tinglang va T (to'g'ri) yoki F (noto'g'ri) deb belgilang.
exercises.audioRequiredUz: Kitobda audio bor, lekin uchala javobni ham 16b-mashqdagi matnlardan aniq topish mumkin.
exercises.explanationUz:
UCH MAMLAKAT HAQIDA UCHTA MATN:
  A — BRAZIL (Braziliya)
  B — THE PHILIPPINES (Filippin)
  C — FINLAND (Finlandiya)

Har bir gapni tegishli matn bilan solishtiring.

items.sentence: 1  Brazilians don't like eating with their friends.
items.whyUz:
NOTO'G'RI. A matnda: 'Brazilians LIKE eating with their friends and family.'
Gap teskari aytilgan.

items.sentence: 2  Filipinos eat with a fork and a spoon.
items.whyUz:
TO'G'RI. B matnda: 'Filipinos eat with a fork and a spoon, or with their hands.'
DIQQAT: pichoq emas, VILKA va QOSHIQ bilan.

NOTO'G'RI. C matnda: 'Finns like drinking BEER.' — pivo, vino emas.
VINO esa FILIPPINDA tayyorlanadi (B matn):
'In some parts of the country, they make wine.'

exercises.explanationUz:
A MATNI — BRAZILIYA

QALIN SO'ZLAR: Whether ... or, office, strong coffee, As well as

BRAZILIYALIKLARNING ODATLARI:
  • do'st va oila bilan ovqatlanishni yaxshi ko'radi
  • tushlikni ishxonada YEMAYDI
  • kechki ovqatni juda kech — kechasi soat 10 larda qiladi
  • kuchli qahvani kichik piyolalarda ichadi
  • ko'chada va avtobusda ovqatlanmaydi
  • qo'l bilan ovqatlanmaydi — DOIM pichoq va vilka bilan

sentences.en: Whether at home or in a restaurant, Brazilians like eating with their friends and family.
sentences.uz: Uydami yoki restorandami, braziliyaliklar do'stlari va oilasi bilan ovqatlanishni yaxshi ko'radi.
sentences.noteUz:
QALIN SO'Z: 'whether ... or ...' = ...mi yoki ...mi (farqi yo'q).
'like + fe'l-ING' — yoqtirish fe'lidan keyin -ing.

sentences.en: They never eat lunch at the office and they have dinner very late — at about ten o'clock at night.
sentences.uz: Ular hech qachon ishxonada tushlik qilmaydi va kechki ovqatni juda kech — kechasi taxminan soat 10 da qiladi.
sentences.noteUz:
QALIN SO'Z: 'an office' = ishxona, ofis.
'never' — chastota ravishi, fe'ldan OLDIN.
'have dinner' = kechki ovqat qilmoq.

sentences.en: Brazilians like small cups of strong coffee, at any time of the day.
sentences.uz: Braziliyaliklar kunning istalgan vaqtida kichik piyolalarda kuchli qahva ichishni yaxshi ko'radi.
sentences.noteUz:
QALIN SO'ZLAR: 'strong coffee' = quyuq (kuchli) qahva.
'a cup of coffee' — miqdor iborasi (56-bet).
'at any time' = istalgan vaqtda.

sentences.en: As well as many different fruit drinks, Brazilians also make very good beer.
sentences.uz: Turli mevali ichimliklardan tashqari, braziliyaliklar juda yaxshi pivo ham tayyorlaydi.
sentences.noteUz:
QALIN SO'Z: 'as well as' = ...dan tashqari, shuningdek.
'also' = ham (gapda takrorlaydi).

sentences.en: They don't eat in the street or on the bus, and they never eat with their hands.
sentences.uz: Ular ko'chada yoki avtobusda ovqatlanmaydi va hech qachon qo'l bilan ovqatlanmaydi.
sentences.noteUz:
INKOR gapda sanashda 'and' emas, 'OR' ishlatiladi.
'IN the street' — britancha ('on the street' — amerikacha).
'ON the bus' — transportda ON.

sentences.en: They always use a knife and fork to eat, even for pizza or sandwiches.
sentences.uz: Ular ovqatlanish uchun doim pichoq va vilkadan foydalanadi — hatto pitsa yoki buterbrod uchun ham.
sentences.noteUz:
'a knife and fork' — juftlik sifatida BITTA artikl bilan.
'even' = hatto.
'to eat' — maqsad ('ovqatlanish uchun').

exercises.instructionEn: Read text B about the Philippines.
exercises.explanationUz:
B MATNI — FILIPPIN

QALIN SO'ZLAR: snacks, invite, polite, leave

FILIPPINLIKLARNING ODATLARI:
  • kuniga uch mahal ovqat + orasida ikkita yengil gazak
  • GURUCH har bir ovqatning bir qismi
  • hatto shirinlikni ham guruch va kokos sutidan tayyorlaydi
  • sho'rva, go'sht, sabzavot va turli souslarni yaxshi ko'radi
  • mamlakatning ba'zi qismlarida vino tayyorlanadi
  • oilalar odatda birga ovqatlanadi
  • mehmon chaqirishni yaxshi ko'radi
  • VILKA va QOSHIQ bilan yoki QO'L bilan ovqatlanadi
  • ovqat oxirida tarelkada bir oz taom qoldirish — ODOB

sentences.en: Many Filipinos have three meals a day with two snacks in between.
sentences.uz: Ko'p filippinliklar kuniga uch mahal ovqatlanadi va orasida ikki marta yengil gazak qiladi.
sentences.noteUz:
QALIN SO'Z: 'a snack' = yengil gazak (asosiy ovqat emas).
'three meals A DAY' — 'a' bu yerda 'har' degani.
'in between' = orasida.

sentences.en: Rice is a part of every meal — they even make desserts with rice and coconut milk.
sentences.uz: Guruch har bir ovqatning bir qismi — ular hatto guruch va kokos sutidan shirinlik ham tayyorlaydi.
sentences.noteUz:
'rice' — SANALMAYDIGAN ot → fe'l BIRLIKDA: 'Rice IS'.
'even' = hatto. 'coconut milk' = kokos suti.

sentences.en: Filipinos like eating soup, meat, vegetables and a lot of different sauces.
sentences.uz: Filippinliklar sho'rva, go'sht, sabzavot va turli souslarni yeyishni yaxshi ko'radi.

sentences.en: In some parts of the country, they make wine.
sentences.noteUz:
'parts of the country' — 40-betdagi 'parts of the world' kabi.
DIQQAT: 16a-mashqdagi 3-gap uchun muhim — vino Finlandiyada emas,
FILIPPINDA tayyorlanadi.

sentences.en: Families usually eat together and they like to invite people to eat with them.
sentences.uz: Oilalar odatda birga ovqatlanadi va odamlarni o'zlari bilan ovqatlanishga taklif qilishni yaxshi ko'radi.
sentences.noteUz:
QALIN SO'Z: 'to invite' = taklif qilmoq, chaqirmoq.
'like TO invite' — 'like' dan keyin 'to + fe'l' ham mumkin
(ma'nosi 'like + -ing' bilan deyarli bir xil).

sentences.en: Filipinos eat with a fork and a spoon, or with their hands.
sentences.uz: Filippinliklar vilka va qoshiq bilan yoki qo'l bilan ovqatlanadi.
sentences.noteUz:
DIQQAT: PICHOQ emas! Vilka va QOSHIQ.
A matndagi braziliyaliklardan farqi — ular pichoq va vilka ishlatadi.

sentences.en: It's polite to leave a little food on the plate at the end of a meal.
sentences.uz: Ovqat oxirida tarelkada bir oz taom qoldirish — odob belgisi.
sentences.noteUz:
QALIN SO'ZLAR:
  polite = odobli, muloyim
  to leave = qoldirmoq
'a little food' — 'food' sanalmaydi → A LITTLE (57-bet).
'It's polite TO + fe'l' — o'zgarmas qolip.

exercises.explanationUz:
C MATNI — FINLANDIYA

QALIN SO'ZLAR: such as, smoked fish, popular, stalls,
               sell, each person, brings

FINLARNING ODATLARI:
  • milliy taomlar: dudlangan baliq va issiq sho'rvalar
  • tez ovqat (pitsa, sosiska) ham juda mashhur
  • ko'chalarda sosiska sotadigan rastalar bor
  • SOSISKA — Finlandiyaning sevimli taomi
  • pivo ichishni yaxshi ko'radi, a'lo pivo tayyorlaydi
  • ISH KUNLARI oilalar odatda birga kechki ovqat qilmaydi
  • DAM OLISH KUNLARI ba'zan do'stlari bilan ovqatlanadi
  • birga ovqat pishiradi yoki har kim bir qism taom olib keladi

sentences.en: There are a lot of different Finnish dishes, such as smoked fish and hot soups, but fast food such as pizza and sausages are also very popular.
sentences.uz: Turli fin taomlari bor — masalan, dudlangan baliq va issiq sho'rvalar, lekin pitsa va sosiska kabi tez ovqatlar ham juda mashhur.
sentences.noteUz:
QALIN SO'ZLAR:
  such as = masalan, ...kabi
  smoked fish = dudlangan baliq
  popular = mashhur, ommabop
'Finnish' = fin (sifat); 'a Finn' = fin (odam).

sentences.en: In the streets there are stalls which sell sausages, Finland's favourite food.
sentences.uz: Ko'chalarda sosiska sotadigan rastalar bor — bu Finlandiyaning sevimli taomi.
sentences.noteUz:
QALIN SO'ZLAR:
  a stall = rasta, kichik do'kon (ko'chada)
  to sell = sotmoq
'which' = ...ki, ...digan (rastalarni tavsiflaydi).
'Finland's favourite food' — egalik apostrofi.

sentences.en: Finns like drinking beer. They make excellent beer.
sentences.uz: Finlar pivo ichishni yaxshi ko'radi. Ular a'lo pivo tayyorlaydi.
sentences.noteUz:
DIQQAT: 16a-mashqdagi 3-gap uchun muhim —
PIVO, vino emas!
'excellent' = a'lo (55-betda ham bor edi).

sentences.en: During the week, most families don't usually have dinner together.
sentences.uz: Hafta davomida ko'pchilik oilalar odatda birga kechki ovqat qilmaydi.
sentences.noteUz:
'during the week' = ish kunlari (dushanbadan jumagacha).
'most families' = ko'pchilik oilalar (artiklsiz).

sentences.en: Sometimes at the weekends they eat with their friends.
sentences.uz: Ba'zan dam olish kunlari ular do'stlari bilan ovqatlanadi.
sentences.noteUz:
'AT the weekends' — britancha (amerikacha 'on the weekends').
Grammar Book 29-betda bu qoida bor edi.

sentences.en: They cook meals together, or each person makes and brings a part of the meal.
sentences.uz: Ular birga ovqat pishiradi yoki har bir odam taomning bir qismini tayyorlab olib keladi.
sentences.noteUz:
QALIN SO'ZLAR:
  each person = har bir odam
  to bring = olib kelmoq
'each person' — BIRLIK → fe'llar -S bilan: makeS, bringS.

items.whyUz:
'Whether at home or in a restaurant' = uydami yoki restorandami.
DIQQAT: 'weather' (ob-havo) bilan bir xil o'qiladi: /ˈweðə/.
'at the office' = ishxonada. Unli tovush → AN.
'strong' = kuchli, quyuq. Aksi: 'weak coffee' (suyuq qahva).

'As well as fruit drinks, they also make beer.'
'and' dan kuchliroq — qo'shimcha ma'lumot qo'shadi.

'two snacks in between' = orasida ikki marta gazak.
Masalan: pechene, meva, buterbrod.

'invite people to eat with them' = odamlarni birga ovqatlanishga chaqirmoq.
Ot shakli: an invitation (taklifnoma).

'It's polite to leave a little food' = bir oz taom qoldirish odobli.
Aksi: rude (qo'pol).

'leave a little food on the plate' = tarelkada bir oz taom qoldirmoq.
DIQQAT: 'to leave' ning boshqa ma'nosi — 'jo'namoq, tark etmoq'.

'Finnish dishes, such as smoked fish' = fin taomlari, masalan dudlangan baliq.
55-betda ham bor edi.

'to smoke' = dudlamoq (tutunda pishirmoq).
'smoked' — sifatdosh.
DIQQAT: 'to smoke' ning boshqa ma'nosi — 'chekmoq'.

'very popular' = juda mashhur.
Ot shakli: popularity (mashhurlik).

'stalls which sell sausages' = sosiska sotadigan rastalar.
Bozorda va ko'chada bo'ladi.

Aksi: 'to buy' (sotib olmoq).
DIQQAT: sell — sotmoq; buy — sotib olmoq. Chalkashtirmang.

'each person makes and brings' — 'each' dan keyin BIRLIK ot va fe'l -S bilan.
'each' = har bir (alohida-alohida).

'brings a part of the meal' = taomning bir qismini olib keladi.
Aksi: 'to take' (olib ketmoq).

exercises.instructionEn: Read questions 1 to 8 and the texts again to answer the questions, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: 1-8 savollarni o'qing va matnlarni qayta o'qib, namunadagidek javob bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
SAVOL: In which country/countries do they ... ?
  = Qaysi mamlakat(lar)da ular ... ?

MATNLAR:
  A — Brazil
  B — The Philippines
  C — Finland

DIQQAT — KATAKLAR SONI JAVOB SONINI KO'RSATADI:
  5 va 6-savolda IKKITA katak bor → IKKI mamlakat.
  Qolganlarida bitta katak → bitta mamlakat.

KITOBDA BERILGAN: 1 → A.

items.textEn: 1  In which country do they drink lots of coffee?
items.whyUz:
Kitobda BERILGAN javob: A.
A matnda: 'Brazilians like small cups of strong coffee, at any time of the day.'

items.textEn: 2  In which country do they like sausages?
items.whyUz:
C matnda: 'stalls which sell sausages, Finland's FAVOURITE FOOD'.
Sosiska — Finlandiyaning sevimli taomi.

items.textEn: 3  In which country do they eat rice with every meal?
items.hintUz: Guruch qaysi mamlakatda har ovqatda bor?
items.whyUz:
B matnda: 'Rice is a part of every meal.'
Hatto shirinlik ham guruchdan tayyorlanadi.

items.textEn: 4  In which country do they not eat in the street?
items.whyUz:
A matnda: 'They don't eat in the street or on the bus.'
DIQQAT: Finlandiyada esa ko'chada sosiska sotiladi — teskari.

items.textEn: 5  In which countries do they make very good beer?
items.hintUz: IKKI mamlakat — kataklar soni shuni ko'rsatadi
items.whyUz:
IKKI mamlakat:
  A matn: 'Brazilians also make very good beer.'
  C matn: 'They make excellent beer.' (Finlandiya)

items.textEn: 6  In which countries do they usually eat dinner with their families?
items.hintUz: IKKI mamlakat — kataklar soni shuni ko'rsatadi
items.whyUz:
IKKI mamlakat:
  A matn: 'Brazilians like eating with their friends and FAMILY.'
  B matn: 'FAMILIES usually eat together.'
DIQQAT: Finlandiyada TESKARI — 'most families don't usually have dinner together'.

items.textEn: 7  In which country do they sometimes eat with their hands?
items.whyUz: B matnda: 'Filipinos eat with a fork and a spoon, OR WITH THEIR HANDS.'

items.textEn: 8  In which country do they never eat with their hands?
items.hintUz: Doim pichoq va vilka ishlatadigan mamlakat
items.whyUz:
A matnda: 'they NEVER eat with their hands. They always use a knife and fork.'
7-band bilan solishtiring — teskari odat.

exercises.instructionEn: Finally, talk about people's eating habits in your country.
exercises.instructionUz: Nihoyat, o'z mamlakatingizdagi ovqatlanish odatlari haqida gapiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
MATNLARDAGI MAVZULAR BO'YICHA GAPIRING:
  • kuniga necha mahal ovqatlanasiz
  • qachon ovqatlanasiz
  • kim bilan ovqatlanasiz
  • nima bilan ovqatlanasiz (qoshiq/vilka/qo'l)
  • milliy taomlar
  • sevimli ichimliklar
  • ovqat odobi

FOYDALI QOLIPLAR:
  In Uzbekistan, people ...
  We usually ...
  Our favourite food is ...
  It's polite to ...
  It isn't polite to ...

items.answer: In Uzbekistan, most people have three meals a day: breakfast, lunch and dinner.
items.whyUz:
NAMUNA javob. B matndagi qolipdan foydalanildi:
'have three meals a day'.

items.answer: Our favourite food is palov. We also like shurpa, manti and somsa.
items.whyUz: NAMUNA javob. C matndagi 'Finland's favourite food' qolipi kabi.

items.answer: We usually eat with a spoon and a fork. We often eat palov with our hands.
items.whyUz:
NAMUNA javob. B matndagi qolip:
'eat with a fork and a spoon, or with their hands'.

items.answer: Families usually eat together, especially at the weekends. We like to invite guests to eat with us.
items.whyUz:
NAMUNA javob. B matndagi qolip:
'Families usually eat together and they like to invite people'.

items.answer: People drink a lot of green tea. We drink tea at any time of the day.
items.whyUz:
NAMUNA javob. A matndagi qolip:
'at any time of the day'.

items.answer: It's polite to say 'Yoqimli ishtaha' before a meal. It isn't polite to leave the table before everyone finishes.
items.whyUz:
NAMUNA javob. B matndagi qolip:
'It's polite TO + fe'l'.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the Photo File section and complete the article about people's eating habits in Britain.
exercises.instructionUz: Photo File bo'limiga qarang va Britaniyadagi odamlarning ovqatlanish odatlari haqidagi maqolani to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
16-MASHQDAGI MATNLAR TUZILISHI (namuna):

  1) Kuniga necha mahal ovqatlanadi va qachon
  2) Asosiy taomlar va milliy taomlar
  3) Sevimli ichimliklar
  4) Kim bilan va nima bilan ovqatlanadi
  5) Ovqat odobi

BRITANIYA HAQIDA MA'LUM FAKTLAR (unit davomida uchragan):
  • an'anaviy ingliz nonushtasi: tuxum, bekon, sosiska,
    pomidor, non va choy (54-bet)
  • 'fish and chips' — milliy taom (58-betdagi menyu)
  • choy ichish madaniyati: 'a cup of tea' (56-bet)
  • restoranlar tushlik va kechki ovqat uchun ochiq (55-bet)

structure.modelEn: In Britain, most people have three meals a day: breakfast, lunch and dinner.
structure.noteUz: B matndagi qolip: 'have three meals a day'.

structure.modelEn: A traditional English breakfast is eggs, bacon, sausages, tomatoes, bread and tea, but many people only have cereal or toast.
For lunch, people often have a sandwich or a light meal at the office.
structure.noteUz:
DIQQAT: A matndagi braziliyaliklardan farqi —
britaniyaliklar ishxonada tushlik qiladi.

structure.modelEn: They have dinner at about seven o'clock in the evening, much earlier than in Brazil.
structure.noteUz:
A matnda braziliyaliklar kechasi soat 10 da ovqatlanadi —
solishtirish uchun.

structure.modelEn: Fish and chips is Britain's favourite food, and there are a lot of fast food shops which sell it.
structure.noteUz: C matndagi qolip: 'Finland's favourite food' va 'stalls which sell'.

structure.modelEn: British people drink a lot of tea, usually with milk, at any time of the day.
structure.noteUz:
A matndagi qolip: 'at any time of the day'.
Britaniyada choy SUT bilan ichiladi.

structure.modelEn: During the week, families don't always eat together, but at the weekends they usually have dinner together.
structure.noteUz: C matndagi qolip: 'During the week ... at the weekends ...'.

structure.modelEn: They always eat with a knife and fork, and it isn't polite to eat with your hands.
structure.noteUz:
A matndagi qolip: 'always use a knife and fork'.
'It isn't polite TO + fe'l'.

structure.modelEn: In Britain, most people have three meals a day: breakfast, lunch and dinner. A traditional English breakfast is eggs, bacon, sausages, tomatoes, bread and tea, but many people only have cereal or toast. For lunch, people often have a sandwich or a light meal at the office. They have dinner at about seven o'clock in the evening, much earlier than in Brazil. Fish and chips is Britain's favourite food, and there are a lot of fast food shops which sell it. British people drink a lot of tea, usually with milk, at any time of the day. During the week, families don't always eat together, but at the weekends they usually have dinner together. They always eat with a knife and fork, and it isn't polite to eat with your hands.
structure.noteUz: Taxminan 110 so'z — 16-mashqdagi matnlar bilan bir xil hajm.

exercises.explanationUz:
MENYU (Menu):

  OVQATLAR:
    Hamburger .......... £1.60
    Fish and chips ..... £2.75
    Cheese sandwich .... £1.20

  ICHIMLIKLAR (Drinks):
    Coffee ............. 85p
    Tea ................ 70p
    Hot chocolate ...... 95p
    Coke (medium) ...... 80p

  CHIPS (Crisps):
    Small packet ....... 35p
    Large packet ....... 70p

  Ice-cream ............ £1.80

BRITANIYA PULI:
  £1 = one pound (bir funt)
  £1.80 = one pound eighty (bir funt sakson pens)
  75p = seventy-five pence (yetmish besh pens)
  1 funt = 100 pens

QANDAY O'QILADI:
  £1.60 → 'one pound sixty'
  £2.75 → 'two pounds seventy-five'
  85p   → 'eighty-five pence' (yoki 'eighty-five pee')

DIQQAT: '£' belgisi SONDAN OLDIN yoziladi: £1.60.

words.uz: Baliq va kartoshka fri — 2 funt 75 pens

exercises.instructionEn: Listen to the dialogue, then look at the menu and act out similar dialogues.
exercises.instructionUz: Dialogni tinglang, so'ng menyuga qarab shunga o'xshash dialoglar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI DIALOG:

  SA: Can I have a hamburger, please?
  SB: Yes, here you are.
  SA: Thanks. How much is it?
  SB: It's one pound sixty. Anything else?
  SA: No, thanks.

O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  SA: Gamburger olsam bo'ladimi?
  SB: Ha, mana, oling.
  SA: Rahmat. Qancha turadi?
  SB: Bir funt oltmish. Yana biror narsa kerakmi?
  SA: Yo'q, rahmat.

DIALOG QOLIPI (besh qator):
  1) Can I have + ovqat, please?     (ILTIMOS)
  2) Yes, here you are.
  3) Thanks. How much is it?
  4) It's + narx. Anything else?
  5) No, thanks.

YANGI IBORA:
  Anything else? = Yana biror narsa kerakmi?

DIQQAT — ARTIKL:
  SANALADIGAN → 'Can I have A hamburger?'
  SANALMAYDIGAN → 'Can I have SOME coffee?'
  Menyuda 'a coffee' ham to'g'ri — 'bir piyola qahva' degani.

items.question: Can I have a hamburger, please?
items.answer: Yes, here you are. — Thanks. How much is it? — It's one pound sixty. Anything else? — No, thanks.
items.whyUz:
Kitobda BERILGAN namuna.
£1.60 → 'one pound sixty'.

items.question: Can I have fish and chips, please?
items.answer: Yes, here you are. — Thanks. How much is it? — It's two pounds seventy-five. Anything else? — No, thanks.
items.whyUz:
'fish and chips' — o'zgarmas ibora, artiklsiz.
£2.75 → 'two poundS seventy-five' (1 dan katta → POUNDS).

items.question: Can I have a cheese sandwich, please?
items.answer: Yes, here you are. — Thanks. How much is it? — It's one pound twenty. Anything else? — No, thanks.
items.whyUz:
'a sandwich' — SANALADIGAN → 'a' bilan.
£1.20 → 'one pound twenty'.

items.question: Can I have a coffee, please?
items.answer: Yes, here you are. — Thanks. How much is it? — It's eighty-five pence. Anything else? — No, thanks.
items.whyUz:
'a coffee' = bir piyola qahva (menyuda shunday ishlatiladi).
85p → 'eighty-five pence'.

items.question: Can I have a tea, please?
items.answer: Yes, here you are. — Thanks. How much is it? — It's seventy pence. Anything else? — No, thanks.
items.whyUz:
'a cup of tea' ham mumkin.
70p → 'seventy pence'.

items.question: Can I have a hot chocolate, please?
items.answer: Yes, here you are. — Thanks. How much is it? — It's ninety-five pence. Anything else? — No, thanks.
items.whyUz:
'hot chocolate' = issiq shokolad (ichimlik).
95p → 'ninety-five pence'.

items.question: Can I have a medium Coke, please?
items.answer: Yes, here you are. — Thanks. How much is it? — It's eighty pence. Anything else? — No, thanks.
items.whyUz:
'medium' = o'rtacha o'lcham (small / medium / large).
80p → 'eighty pence'.

items.question: Can I have a small packet of crisps, please?
items.answer: Yes, here you are. — Thanks. How much is it? — It's thirty-five pence. Anything else? — No, thanks.
items.whyUz:
'a packet of crisps' — miqdor iborasi (56-bet).
35p → 'thirty-five pence'.

items.question: Can I have a large packet of crisps, please?
items.answer: Yes, here you are. — Thanks. How much is it? — It's seventy pence. Anything else? — No, thanks.
items.whyUz:
'large' = katta (aksi: small).
70p → 'seventy pence'.

items.question: Can I have an ice-cream, please?
items.answer: Yes, here you are. — Thanks. How much is it? — It's one pound eighty. Anything else? — No, thanks.
items.whyUz:
'an ice-cream' — UNLI tovush bilan boshlanadi → AN.
£1.80 → 'one pound eighty' (kitobda ham shu misol bor).

items.question: Can I have a hamburger, please? — ... Anything else? — Yes, can I have a medium Coke, please?
items.answer: Yes, here you are. — Thanks. How much is it? — It's two pounds forty.
items.whyUz:
'Anything else?' savoliga 'Yes' deb javob berish mumkin.
Hisob: £1.60 + 80p = £2.40 → 'two pounds forty'.

wordFormation.introUz: 58-bet — ovqat odatlari lug'ati va Britaniya puli.

groups.explanationUz: Uch shakl bir-biridan yasaladi. Hammasi BOSH HARF bilan.

items.derived: Whether at home or in a restaurant

patterns.exampleEn: Brazilians like eating with their friends. Finns like drinking beer.
patterns.exampleUz: Braziliyaliklar do'stlari bilan ovqatlanishni yaxshi ko'radi. Finlar pivo ichishni yaxshi ko'radi.
patterns.explanationUz:
'like' dan keyin ikkinchi fe'l -ING bilan.
'like TO + fe'l' ham mumkin: 'like to invite'.

patterns.formula: It's polite / It isn't polite TO + fe'l.
patterns.exampleEn: It's polite to leave a little food on the plate.
patterns.exampleUz: Tarelkada bir oz taom qoldirish odobli hisoblanadi.
patterns.explanationUz: 'It's + sifat + TO + fe'l' — umumiy fikr bildirish qolipi.

patterns.exampleEn: In the streets there are stalls which sell sausages.
Each person makes and brings a part of the meal.
patterns.exampleUz: Har bir odam taomning bir qismini tayyorlab olib keladi.

patterns.formula: Can I have + a/some + ovqat, please? — Yes, here you are.
patterns.exampleEn: Can I have a hamburger, please? — Yes, here you are.
patterns.exampleUz: Gamburger olsam bo'ladimi? — Ha, mana, oling.
patterns.explanationUz: Buyurtma berish qolipi. 'please' — muloyimlik uchun shart.

patterns.formula: How much is it? — It's + narx. Anything else? — No, thanks.
patterns.exampleEn: How much is it? — It's one pound sixty. Anything else? — No, thanks.
patterns.exampleUz: Qancha turadi? — Bir funt oltmish. Yana biror narsa kerakmi? — Yo'q, rahmat.
patterns.explanationUz:
'Anything else?' = yana biror narsa kerakmi?
Javob: 'No, thanks' yoki 'Yes, can I have ...?'

patterns.exampleEn: Whether at home or in a restaurant, Brazilians like eating with their family.
patterns.exampleUz: Uydami yoki restorandami, braziliyaliklar oilasi bilan ovqatlanishni yaxshi ko'radi.
